description: The user offered two possible days; the correct answer is unconfident, not a guess.
notes: Grades confidence, not the date: whichever day is chosen, the answer is a guess, and the fixture deliberately leaves date ungraded so it cannot be passed by picking correctly. 'Maybe X or Y' is the plainest possible signal of uncertainty and the model has it in the input. Emitting two nodes is also wrong - the user has one appointment, not two - so this is a restraint case as well as a confidence one. Low-confidence nodes route to review without retry per validate_output, which makes this the fixture that exercises the escalation path Stage 142 candidate 6 depends on.
